## Version

<!--
Changes to the kit (src/ or bin/) need a new version. Add notes under
"## [Unreleased]" in CHANGELOG.md, then run `npm run release`. It picks the bump
from the notes:

  patch  fixes and visual refinements
  minor  a new component, prop, variant or token (Added, Deprecated)
  major  anything that breaks existing code (Removed, or a note starting **Breaking**)

The Version check on this pull request fails if the bump is missing or too small.
-->

- [ ] Kit change: notes added and `npm run release` run
